_comment: Workbook exercise air-sat-reset (docs/workbook/air-sat-reset.md), lbnl-ddahu part: the cold deck's supply-air temperature (CSA_TEMP, mapped as supply_air_temp) against OAT. `camber datasets config lbnl-ddahu --exercise air-sat-reset--lbnl-ddahu --store DIR --out cfg.json` fills in the store path. Since 0.100 (#98) the cold-deck setpoint CSA_TEMPSPT is mapped as supply_air_temp_sp: it is 55.0 in every row (see the data issue economizer-sat-reset-absent), so supply_air_reset reads it as a flat setpoint, not reset, rather than inferring the reset from the supply air's shape (before 0.100 it was not mapped and the verdict came from the shape: SAT pinned low at ~55 F, the same warn); supply_air_reset_compliance compares it with the Guideline 36 OAT reset target at its defaults. Both judge fan-on (CSF_CS), operate-mode (SYS_CTL) samples. The hot deck is not judged: it heats to its own setpoint by design.
